name: fee-report
title: Fee report
for_each: select p.id, p.number || ' ' || p.name as name from projects p where p.status in ('active', 'proposal') and exists (select 1 from stages s where s.project_id = p.id and s.fee_type <> 'none') order by p.number

sections.title: Stages
sections.sql: select stage, fee_type as basis, total_fee as fee, percent_complete as complete, earned, invoiced, wip as to_invoice from stage_position where project_id = $1 order by sort

sections.title: Variations
sections.sql: select name as variation, description, fee, status, decided_on from variations where project_id = $1 order by name

sections.title: Invoices
sections.sql: select name as invoice, issued_on, total, paid, balance from invoice_balances where project_id = $1 and status <> 'draft' order by issued_on

name: payment-claim
title: Invoice and payment claim
for_each: select id, name from invoices where status <> 'void' and not opening_balance order by name

sections.title: Claim
sections.note: Where this invoice is served as a payment claim under the Construction Contracts Act 2002, it states the amount claimed, the due date, the period it covers and how it was calculated. A claim to a residential occupier carries the prescribed Form 1.
sections.sql: select b.name as invoice, b.client, b.number || ' ' || b.project as project, b.issued_on, b.due_on, case when b.payment_claim then 'yes' else 'no' end as payment_claim from invoice_balances b where b.id = $1

sections.title: How it was calculated
sections.sql: select l.name as item, l.kind, l.amount from invoice_lines l where l.invoice_id = $1 order by l.kind, l.name

sections.title: Total
sections.sql: select net as excluding_gst, round(total - net, 2) as gst, total, paid, balance as claimed_now from invoice_balances where id = $1

name: variation
title: Variation for approval
for_each: select id, name from variations where status in ('draft', 'submitted') order by name

sections.title: Variation
sections.sql: select v.name as variation, p.number || ' ' || p.name as project, s.name as stage, v.description, v.fee as fee_excluding_gst from variations v join projects p on p.id = v.project_id join stages s on s.id = v.stage_id where v.id = $1

sections.title: Approval
sections.note: Work on this variation starts once the client approves it in writing.
sections.sql: select '' as approved_by, '' as date where $1::uuid is not null
